parsed_json.up: Select molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name as molecule_name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for compounds reported in document CHEMBL4393657. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and INNER JOIN compound_structures on molregno to require structures. Filter by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4393657'. Return rows sorted by molecule ChEMBL ID ascending.
